metadata.coverage: 1956-01 to 2026-08 skeleton; actual variable coverage and completeness differ. Pre-1984 monthly values are absent, not zero.
metadata.ndvi: Seasonal MOD13Q1.061 windows, not independent monthly points; repeated window IDs must not be counted twice.
metadata.lake: lake_qualified=original explicit_dual95_gate_recomputed (all months); lake_core_qualified=original core_month_qualified (Jun-Sep); lake_primary_eligible=exact frozen lake_primary_59_pairs.csv membership. Classification dispute is independent, never silently excluded. Winter zero is not dry.
metadata.radiation: Original frozen monthly field, MJ/m²/day; see source era labels
